pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pStudies a sample and unlocks its category for the owner or configured shared research state.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place the chamber with a valid owner.$p2. Insert a sample listed in Research.$p3. Supply study energy and wait for completion.$p4. Read the unlock message and retry the newly available recipe.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pA sample for an already unlocked group will not repeatedly create rewards. Sample consumption is a separate server option.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
